properties.note: 1,5-hexadien-3-ol, lowest-energy conformer of the B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP gas-phase screen; 0 imaginary frequencies. This minimum is both the barrier reference and the conformer the TS1 IRC actually reaches: re-optimising the reactant-side IRC outer frame gives -309.627491845 Ha (jobs/ts1/ts1_epB_rc.log), i.e. the same minimum.

Concerted chair [3,3]-sigmatropic oxy-Cope saddle; exactly one imaginary frequency -461.04 cm-1 dominated by the coupled C3-C5 (map 3-4, breaking) and C1-C7 (map 1-6, forming) motion; dE‡ = 39.2 kcal/mol vs rc_c2.
hexa-1,5-dien-1-ol, the [3,3] product enol; 0 imaginary frequencies; the OH is synperiplanar to the C=C (H-O-C=C = 0.3 deg), preorganized for the 1,3-H shift.
Uncatalysed 4-membered suprafacial 1,3-H shift saddle; one imaginary frequency -2122.81 cm-1 (93.5% H8); dE‡ = 58.1 kcal/mol vs the enol minimum.

hex-5-enal, lowest conformer (prod_c0); 0 imaginary frequencies. The step2 IRC reaches a conformer 2.78 kcal/mol higher (jobs/ts2/ep/ts2_epA_ald.log, -309.645051789); the declared product energy stays prod_c0.

edges.note: Barrier reference is the reactant minimum rc_c2 (E = -309.627491834, jobs/rc_c2/rc_c2_optfreq.log); dE = E(TS1) - E(rc_c2) = 39.2 kcal/mol, electronic only (no ZPE/thermal). The bidirectional IRC (jobs/ts1/ts1_irc4.log) leaves the saddle in both directions; re-optimising its reactant-side outer frame gives -309.627491845 Ha (jobs/ts1/ts1_epB_rc.log), i.e. the same rc_c2 minimum, and its enol-side outer frame gives -309.631467076 Ha (jobs/ts1/ts1_epA_enol.log), an enol conformer 0.17 kcal/mol above the declared enol reference enol_c0 (-309.631745145).

Barrier reference is the enol minimum enol_c0 (E = -309.631745145, jobs/enol_c0/enol_c0_optfreq.log); dE = E(TS2) - E(enol_c0) = 58.1 kcal/mol, electronic only, and this is the rate-determining step of the network. Both IRC directions (jobs/ts2/ts2_irc.log) leave the saddle: the enol-side outer frame re-optimises to -309.631745132 Ha, the same enol_c0 minimum, while the product-side outer frame re-optimises to the hex-5-enal conformer -309.645051789 Ha (jobs/ts2/ep/ts2_epA_ald.log), 2.78 kcal/mol above the declared product reference prod_c0 (-309.649483745). The declared product energy stays prod_c0.
